DataTable widget

Source: R/widget-datatable.R
DataTable-class.Rd

A virtualised table for data frames or lazy table sources. See data_table().

Super class

Widget -> DataTable

Public fields

paint_states

Cursor and scroll changes only repaint.

focusable

Tables can be focused.

cursor_type

"row", "cell" or "none".

show_header

Show the header row?

zebra

Stripe alternate rows?

row_style

NULL or function(row, data) returning a style for a data row (row is the original row number or source position).

cell_style

NULL or function(value, row, column) returning a style for a cell.

frozen_columns

Number of leading columns that stay visible while the others scroll horizontally.

header_sort

Clicking a header sorts by that column (click again: descending, then unsorted; Shift+click adds a column)?

editable

Allow editing cells (Enter / double click)?

on_edit

NULL or function(row, column, value) called before a cell edit is applied; return NULL / TRUE to accept or a message to reject the edit.

Active bindings

data

The data frame or source (assigning calls set_data()).

row_count

Number of rows in the current view.

column_names

Names of the data columns.

cursor_row

Cursor position in the view (0 = none).

cursor_column

Cursor column number (cell cursor; 0 = none).

offset_row, offset_column

Scroll offsets (rows / columns).

view

Row numbers or source view positions in display order.

sort_state

NULL or a data frame (column, decreasing) of the current sort keys.

match_hit

NULL or the current search result (position, row, column).

DataTable$new()

Create a table. See data_table().

Usage

DataTable$new(
  data,
  cursor = "row",
  columns = NULL,
  formatters = NULL,
  row_names = NA,
  header = TRUE,
  zebra = FALSE,
  row_style = NULL,
  cell_style = NULL,
  max_column_width = 40L,
  frozen_columns = 0L,
  header_sort = FALSE,
  editable = FALSE,
  on_edit = NULL,
  id = NULL,
  classes = NULL,
  style = NULL,
  disabled = FALSE
)

Arguments

data

A data frame, matrix, or table_source().

cursor

Cursor type.

columns

Named list of column() options.

formatters

Named list of formatter functions.

row_names

Show row names? NA: only when they are not 1..n.

header

Show the header?

zebra

Stripe rows?

row_style, cell_style

Style hooks.

max_column_width

Upper limit for estimated widths.

frozen_columns, header_sort, editable, on_edit

See the fields.

id, classes, style, disabled

See Widget.

filters

Named column filters for filter_columns().

DataTable$sort()

Sort the view by one or more columns (stable; NAs last). Sorting always starts from the unsorted view (after filter()), so sort(c("cyl", "mpg")) sorts by cyl, then mpg.

Usage

DataTable$sort(by, decreasing = FALSE)

Arguments

by

Column names or numbers.

decreasing

Sort in decreasing order? One value, or one per column.

DataTable$clear_sort()

Remove the sort order (back to the order before sorting).

Usage

DataTable$clear_sort()

DataTable$toggle_sort()

Header-click behaviour: sort by a column ascending, then descending, then unsorted.

Usage

DataTable$toggle_sort(column, add = FALSE)

Arguments

column

Column name or number.

add

Add the column to the existing sort (secondary key)?

DataTable$filter()

Show a subset of rows (in the given order), or all rows.

Usage

DataTable$filter(rows = NULL)

Arguments

rows

Row numbers of the data, a logical vector over the rows, or NULL for all rows.

DataTable$filter_columns()

Filter named columns; all predicates are combined with AND and evaluated in row chunks. A predicate may be a table_filter() or function(values) logical.

Usage

DataTable$filter_columns(filters = NULL)

Arguments

filters

Named list by column; NULL clears column filters.

DataTable$auto_size_column()

Fit a column to its content. Rows are sampled, never all scanned unless asked for, so this is fast for huge tables.

Usage

DataTable$auto_size_column(column, rows = c("sample", "visible", "all"))

Arguments

column

Column name or number.

rows

"sample" (the visible rows plus the first and last 500; default), "visible" (visible rows only) or "all" (every row of the view; slow for millions of rows).

DataTable$auto_size_all()

Fit every visible column to its content.

Usage

DataTable$auto_size_all(rows = c("sample", "visible", "all"))

Arguments

rows

See auto_size_column().

DataTable$find()

Search the formatted cell text and move the cursor to the first match at or after the cursor (reading order, wrapping around). Large tables are scanned in chunks; the data is never converted to one big string matrix.

Usage

DataTable$find(query, column = NULL, case_sensitive = FALSE, regex = FALSE)

Arguments

query

Text or regular expression (PCRE).

column

Search only this column (name or number); NULL: all visible columns.

case_sensitive

Match case?

regex

Is query a regular expression?

Returns

TRUE if there is a match (invisibly).

DataTable$set_cell()

Change one cell of the table's own copy of the data (the data frame you passed in is never modified; read the result with $data). Runs on_edit, then sends "datatable.cell_changed" with row, column, old and value.

Usage

DataTable$set_cell(row, column, value)

Arguments

row

Original row number.

column

Column name or number.

value

New value (must fit the column type).

DataTable$on_mouse_down()

Mouse: clicking a row moves the cursor, clicking the header sends "datatable.header_selected" (and sorts when header_sort is on); dragging a column separator in the header resizes the column; a double click edits a cell of an editable table.

Usage

Arguments

event
